eyebrow: Start with a Scheduled Path, then Decision
code:
Case - After Save - SLA Escalation
Start: Case, After Save
Scheduled Path: 4 Hours After CreatedDate
Decision: Still Open and Unescalated?
  Status != Closed AND Escalated__c = False
caption: A Scheduled Path lets the flow come back and re-check the record later, not just at creation.

eyebrow: Get the team, loop to collect only
code:
Get Case Team Members:
  CaseTeamMember WHERE ParentId = Case.Id

Loop: teamMembers
  Add Member.Email to emailCollection
End Loop
caption: Bulkified — the loop builds a collection, it never sends anything itself.

code:
Assignment: Escalated__c = True
            Priority = "High"

Send Email -> {!emailCollection}
  (one call, not one per team member)
caption: Six team members, one email action — the pattern Lesson 22 warned you to avoid putting inside the loop.
